overloadMerges.note: type has exactly two documented values (list/cross-table); modeled as sentinelValues rather than a bare Integer.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Sets (or changes) the report type of an area; changing the type on an existing report discards its previous settings and creates a new empty report.

constraints: Setting a new type on an area that already has a report removes the previous settings and creates a new, empty report.
